column2: no single maker: a composite viola body. The back length, the three bout widths and the f-hole placement are printed for the viola by Antonio Stradivari, Cremona, 1727, 'Cassavetti' (Library of Congress); the thicknesses, arching heights, ribs, bass bar section, soundpost and bridge size are a violin maker's typical Medium values (Hans Johannsson's viola table); the shapes are il Cannone's (Guarneri del Gesu 1743, ESRF CT); PROVENANCE.tsv states each mapping
